name: Cincinnati (United States)
description: A white field with three wavy blue stripes across the centre, overlaid by a red 'C' enclosing a winged caduceus and scimitar device.
history: Designed in 1895 and officially adopted in 1940; the wavy stripes are the Ohio River and the C encloses devices from the city's seal.

features.role: 'C' for Cincinnati enclosing emblems from the city seal
